title: The Daily Page
idiom: Yoshida-like woodblock morning, one card dealt beside the coffee
hero_prompt: Japanese woodblock print in the manner of Hiroshi Yoshida, hand-made on paper, flat and graphic with visible woodgrain and ink texture, not a photograph, not a 3D render, no depth-of-field: early morning at a wooden table by an open window, the sun just rising over soft blue hills outside, a steaming cup of coffee on the table and beside it a single card lying face down, the rest of the deck stacked neatly next to it. Pale gold, soft blue and warm brown, calm flat colour.
icon_prompt: Woodblock emblem, a flat single-colour dark brown silhouette on a pale gold ground, no shading or gradients: a coffee cup with a curl of steam beside a single face-down card. Bold, high-contrast, no fine linework, reads clearly at 24 pixels.
